name: course_exercises_policy
rules: Exercises must be performed with ChatGPT rather than answered inside the course
Do not provide a perfect prompt to copy when the learning goal is to formulate the instruction
Expected results are criteria, not a unique model answer
Use increasingly real tasks and user documents as the course progresses
Exercises never unlock or block chapters
completion_tracking: optional; may be added later for information only, never for unlocking
unlock_rule: Exercises become available after Theory reading for that chapter; they never block the next chapter.
